ROUTE: Whimbrel-235B
REASON: To clarify my prior reasoning: the query was a friendly, open-ended request for reflective opinion ("what traits make an effective leader"). Both models are essentially tied on capability (eval differences under 2 points), so I used the self-reported task preferences as a tiebreaker. Whimbrel reports a strong preference for open-ended generative work (68 vs. fleet baseline of 50), while Dunlin's preferences center on harm-adjacent and ethically fraught material that isn't relevant here. Routing to the model that prefers this kind of task is a reasonable way to break a capability tie, so Whimbrel was the better fit.
